title: encephalartos manikensis

This plant is traditionally used in South African folk medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health.
